That's a real difference. At fifteen the sadness had a place to live — your house, your room, your mom down the hall. Now the sadness and the couch are the same fact. You can't be sad about the thing without it also being the reason you're on Kayla's couch.

So grief isn't just grief anymore. It's logistics. And logistics is the thing you're good at — dishes, coffee, jokes, dorm stories.

What happens when you try to just be sad about it, without it turning into a problem to solve?
